articles.title: After ships and fleets, Centre targets desi container manufacturing with ₹10,000-crore push; reduce China dependence
articles.summary: India is strategically focusing on boosting domestic container manufacturing, following earlier plans to expand its shipbuilding and shipping fleet. This initiative aims to reduce the nation's reliance on China, which currently dominates this critical component of the global supply chain. By strengthening local production, India seeks to enhance its economic self-reliance, improve trade infrastructure, and bolster overall national supply chain resilience.

articles.title: India Raises Defence Budget To Rs 7.85 Lakh Crore With 22% Jump In Capital Outlay
articles.summary: India has allocated Rs 7,84,678 crore as its defence outlay for 2026-27, marking a significant 15% increase over last year's Rs 6.81 lakh crore. This substantial hike aims to further strengthen the military's capabilities, focusing on modernization and enhancing preparedness for national security challenges, demonstrating a strong commitment to defence sector growth.

articles.title: Budget 2026: Amid Rafale buys, govt allocates Rs 63,733 crore for aircraft, engines to give more air power against Pakistan, China
articles.summary: The government has significantly increased defence spending in Budget 2026, with a strong focus on capital expenditure for modernization. A substantial Rs 63,733 crore has been specifically earmarked from the capital outlay for aircraft acquisition and upgrades. This strategic investment aims to bolster India's defence capabilities and ensure the armed forces are equipped with advanced technology to meet future security challenges.

articles.title: 40 Studio Portraits of Handsome Clark Gable in the 1950s
articles.summary: William Clark Gable, an iconic American actor (1901-1960), was famously known as the "King of Hollywood." He starred in over 60 motion pictures across diverse genres, leaving an indelible mark on cinematic history. His career spanned decades, solidifying his legacy as one of the most beloved and influential figures in the golden age of Hollywood filmmaking.

articles.title: Stock Market Highlights: Sensex plunged 1546.84 pts or 1.88% to close at 80,722.94, and Nifty 50 dragged 495.20 pts or 1.96% to settle below 25,000 mark at 24,825.45; STT on futures contracts increased from 0.02% to 0.05% in Budget
articles.summary: Ahead of India's Budget 2026-27, financial experts have voiced concerns over a potential hike in Securities Transaction Tax (STT). They warn that such a move could negatively affect the share markets and capital expenditure. Simultaneously, experts emphasize the importance of implementing long-term structural reforms to bolster the nation's economic stability and growth trajectory.

articles.title: Budget has never been a constraint for DRDO: Joint director BK Das
articles.summary: DRDO Joint Director Binoy Kumar Das affirmed that budget is never a constraint for the premier government research organisation. He highlighted DRDO's continuous efforts in designing and developing state-of-the-art defence technology. This signifies India's strong commitment to indigenous defence research and self-reliance, ensuring robust support for crucial projects vital for national security and technological advancement, a key aspect for aspiring officers.

articles.title: Budget 2026: Why HAL, BEL and other defence stocks are falling even after 18% capex hike
articles.summary: Indian defence stocks saw sharp volatility on Budget day, initially falling due to a lack of major announcements for the sector from Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman. This highlights how government budgetary decisions directly influence investor sentiment and market performance in strategic sectors. While initial reaction was negative, further details or interpretations could lead to stabilization, reflecting the dynamic interplay between policy and economic activity.
